items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: That band was uh Joe Oliver, Freddy Keppler, Manuel Perez. See. Big Eye Louie on clarinet. It was a very good brass band.

ctx.x: Who does he say that? I never take it.
He mentioned that you talked about Keppert, Perez, Vega.
No, no. There you go. I mean, that's what I mean. You see, none of them don't mention the white trumpet player. Vega? Vega was white.
